alt: Engraving of the chest of a newborn opened from the front, showing the two-lobed thymus lying on the pericardium between the lungs, with the thyroid gland, trachea, thyroid veins, right vagus, superior vena cava, left common carotid artery, left internal jugular vein and left subclavian vessels labelled around it. (Gray's Anatomy 1918, plate 1178)
